correctness.rationale: Exact monomial norms produce Eq. (1). Dominated convergence gives a nonzero inner limit; a Laurent reindexing gives the annulus bilateral series with geometric uniform bounds. Ramanujan product Eq. (4) excludes zeros and gives winding -1 on each fixed intermediate radius, so argument principle yields exactly m-1 zeros eventually. Subharmonic compactness and the exact Laplacian of max(log a,log|s|) give weak Haar equidistribution for these m-1 zeros. Numerical checker reproduced six windings and three product identities, but is not the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The exact m-1 bulk zero count and circle weak limit for exponentially increasing heights of one two-step radial weight are not implied by the inspected nearest works: Zeytuncu 2010 and Della Pella 2014 show at least one zero for selected steps; Perälä 2017 constructs arbitrarily many using iterated associated weights; Gafai–Murid–Wahid 2022 supplies only the bilateral Szegő product as a known tool. Relevant reported findings treat other radial functions or other zero types. Searches are evidence, not a proof of absolute historical priority.

value.rationale: The precise growth m-1 and limiting Haar circle measure are natural quantitative invariants of a single-jump radial family, refining the 2010–2017 qualitative Lu Qi-Keng literature. They provide an unbounded zero-count phenomenon with exact arithmetic count in an unusually simple piecewise-constant weight, rather than a novel example alone. No unnecessary general theorem or unproved classification of outer-boundary zeros is asserted.
